data.current_summary:
##General

  - Only open contracts can be updated.
  - Please see 'Create Contract' validation rules.
  - To close a contract update the TerminationDate and TerminationReason.
  - There must be at least one open Role and one open Component on an open Contract.

###Create Role:
  - To add a new role to the contract, add a role into the list of roles.

###Update/Close Role:
  - If a role is not present in the request, it will be deleted.

###Create Component:
  - To add a new component to a contract, add a component (without a component id) to the list of components.

###Update/Remove Component:
  - If a component is not present in the request, it will be deleted.

###Read Only Attributes:
  - Contract: brand, source, referenceId, systemCode, type, executedDate.

  - Component: productType, componentType, issueDate.

  - Role: customerId, contractSystemCustomerId, startDate.
data.summary_suggestion: Update contract details, roles, and components
data.description_suggestion: Updates an open contract and its associated roles and components in Contracts Master. Only open contracts can be modified. Supports adding new roles/components (omit ID), updating existing ones, or removing them (omit from request). Closing a contract requires setting TerminationDate and TerminationReason. Read-only attributes (brand, source, referenceId, systemCode, type, executedDate for contracts; productType, componentType, issueDate for components; customerId, contractSystemCustomerId, startDate for roles) cannot be modified. An open contract must maintain at least one open role and one open component. Returns the updated contract object.

data.current_summary:
Supports adding a contract to the Contracts Master.

  - A contract must be assigned to an active Customer.
  - When a contract is created, a unique identifier (Contract ID) is created for the contract.
  - A new Contract can be created as long as there is no other OPEN Contract with the same reference Id. If a contract exists,
  it can be updated via the update contract end point.

###Validation Rules

####Mandatory Attributes:

  - Contract: brand, source, referenceId, type, executedDate, at least one open component and one open role.
  - Component: statusType, productType, componentType and issueDate.
  - Role: customerId, type and contractSystemCustomerId.

####Dates

  - Contract
    - executedDate should not be after endDate.
    - executedDate should not be after terminationDate.
    - endDate may be set to null for open-ended contracts.
    - terminationDate should be before or the same as endDate.

  - Component
    - issueDate should not be after expiryDate.
    - Component executedDate should not be after Contract issueDate.

  - Role
    - startDate should not be after endDate.
data.summary_suggestion: Create a new contract in Contracts Master
data.description_suggestion: Creates a new contract in Contracts Master and assigns a unique Contract ID. The contract must be assigned to an active customer and cannot duplicate an existing OPEN contract with the same reference ID. Requires mandatory attributes: brand, source, referenceId, type, executedDate, at least one open role, and at least one open component. Each role requires customerId, type, and contractSystemCustomerId; each component requires statusType, productType, componentType, and issueDate. Date validations apply: executedDate must not exceed endDate or terminationDate; terminationDate must not exceed endDate; component issueDate must not exceed expiryDate; role startDate must not exceed endDate. Returns the newly created contract object with the generated Contract ID.
